message.content:
**1. Where the pain is:**  
It’s right under the left side of my ribs – the left upper part of my belly. It stays there; I don’t feel it moving to my back, my shoulder, or anywhere else.

**2. How it started and how it’s changed:**  
It started about 8 days ago as a mild ache in that spot. I thought it was just a stomach bug, so I didn’t do anything special, but the pain never got better. Over the last couple of days it’s gotten noticeably worse and now it’s pretty constant. I’d say the pain is around a 6 or 7 out of 10 right now. It didn’t seem to start after any particular meal or after drinking alcohol – it just came on gradually and has been getting stronger.
